ai.title: CLI owns the active run before streaming and applies reason-based
ai.summary: The CLI replaces the old abort-only active-run registry with a reason-tagged stop path: stopActiveRun now takes an ActiveRunStopReason and consults ACTIVE_RUN_QUEUE_POLICIES to decide whether to pause-if-pending, clear-and-block, or preserve-and-block the message queue. use-send-message owns cancellation with a per-run AbortController and a UUID owner registered via registerActiveRun before the first await, so a stale run settling late cannot release a newer run's lock; the message queue guards dequeue and watchdog resets behind a queueProcessingOwnerRef Symbol. chat-runtime-context registers a persistent stop handler that applies the policy to the current queue controls, and app, chat, command-registry, use-freebuff-session, use-exit-handler, freebuff-exit, and renderer-cleanup now all call stopActiveRun with a concrete reason.
ai.evidence: cli/src/utils/active-run.ts replaces the abort-only registry with stopActiveRun(reason) + ACTIVE_RUN_QUEUE_POLICIES and registerActiveRunStopHandler; cli/src/hooks/use-message-queue.ts adds queueProcessingOwnerRef with Symbol ownership so a stale send cannot release a newer queue lock; cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts switches from clearActiveRunAborter/setActiveRunAborter to registerActiveRun/clearActiveRun and owns cancellation before the first await; cli/src/contexts/chat-runtime-context.tsx registers the runtime owner and wires queue controls; tests in cli/src/commands/__tests__/command-args.test.ts cover cancellation reasons and /logout stopping the owned run.

changes.what: Replaces setActiveRunAborter/clearActiveRunAborter/abortActiveRun with a reason-tagged registry exposing registerActiveRun, clearActiveRun, stopActiveRun, registerActiveRunStopHandler, and ACTIVE_RUN_QUEUE_POLICIES mapping each reason to a queue policy.

Adds a queueProcessingOwnerRef Symbol guard so the watchdog and finally callbacks only release locks owned by the current dequeue, and introduces pauseQueueIfPending, discardQueue, and addToQueueFront for head-of-queue requeueing under ownership.

Switches to registerActiveRun/clearActiveRun ownership with a per-run AbortController created before the first await, passes abortController.signal into prepareUserMessage and createEventHandlerState, and gates late error saves behind runChatIsCurrent.

Removes abortControllerRef/stopStreaming/pauseQueue from the runtime surface, registers a persistent stop handler that applies the reason policy to queue controls, and exposes addToQueueFront and setCanProcessQueue to the message queue.
Adds an optional AbortSignal param to prepareUserMessage and setupStreamingContext so preflight cancellation can abort message creation and image processing.
Adds an isActive() guard to EventHandlerState so late SDK callbacks are rejected after a run loses chat ownership, while still accepting the finish event for cost accounting.
